name: Kakushi-sama
source: Mountain god that resides in Okakushiyama. A guardian, protector that watch over the village. [spoiler]Ever since his promise with protagonist, he eagerly wait until the day come when he can marry the protagonist. He disguised himself by appearing as a human inside the village by the name Kagami with the profession as a doctor who looks after the protagonist.[/spoiler]
